records.deidentified_narrative: while on patrol police responded to the above listed location for a major vehicle accident. callers stated that a female (p1) had her legs run over by a garbage truck. myself and cover officers made the call location and secured the immediate area while blocking off traffic. by the time i made the listed location the female was already loaded into an ambulance being treated by ems. w1 had stated to one of my cover officers that p1 had appeared to be asleep in the alleyway, inside of a small ""niche"" on some steps that led to a door into one of the buildings. w1 stated that it did not appear that d1 saw p1 when he was driving u1 out of the alleyway. w1 stated that u1 had left the locationat this time i attempted to speak to p1 but due to what i believed to be her intoxicated state and the pain of her injury's, i was unable to get much from her as far as the accident itself. at this time i was advised by ems that they where going to transport p1. at this time i was advised by dispatch that d1 was calling in with his current location. i sent a cover officer to speak with d1 while i contacted a gap detective and advised them of the situation. i called for a csi to make the call location and process the scene. while cover officers waited for csi to make the call location, [roadway] to d1's nearby location. i made contact with d1 at 100 block of east martin. i made contact with d1 who stated that he was calling in for a welfare check on a homeless female who was screaming in the alley since he had arrived. d1 stated that he had heard the females voice yelling ""get out of my house!"". d1 stated that he has been in the area before and had to deal with numerous homeless people and so he felt unsafe getting down from his vehicle to see what was going on. i asked d1 to describe what happened exactly. d1 stated that he backed into the alley to collect some trash. d1 stated that this was around the time that he heard the female yelling about her house. d1 stated that he completed his [roadway] out. d1 stated that he still heard d1 yelling but assumed it was over the same thing as before. d1 stated that he exited the alley and relocated nearby to pull over and call the police for a well-fare check. at this time i asked d1 if he saw p1 . d1 stated that he did not. i advised d1 at this time that as to p1's injury's. d1 continued to claim that he did not see p1 and that he didn't run over her on purpose. d1 was advised that he would have to wait until i received callback from the detective as to how we would proceed. at this time i was again contacted by the gap detective and advised him of the update. i was advised to write a mvp'ed. csi made the call location and processed u1 and then headed to sam-c to process p1's injury's. i collected d1's information and the trash trucks, then gave d1 a [case id]. i was advised tid detectives where not available and would not be making the location. cover officers advised sgt. orozco #3372 of the incident. dmea

[person] that approximately 20 minutes prior to my arrival, a vehicle struck him as [roadway]. i asked [person] type of vehicle was it to which he stated a white in color dodge ram driven by vehicle was driven by an elderly white male subject. rangel stated the male driver stopped and asked him if he was okay but he did not reply as he was unconscious due to impact. as we were speaking, rangel kept complaining about chest pain. i was able to observe a laceration on rangels bottom part of the chin as well as some bleeding in his left forearm, and hand. a male subject matching description given by rangel arrived at scene and rangel was able to identified him as the actor of the accident. moments later port isabel medic arrived at scene [medical facility]. i made contact with the male subject who was later identified as robert samuel sirvello (unit 1 driver) ([date]). [person] that [roadway] of the 1600 block of tx-100 facing east, as he was waiting for traffic to enter 1653 tx-100 (stripes 70) as he needed to purchase some items. [person] that it was very dark outside and he could barely see his surroundings. [person] he ran over rangel as he conducted a [roadway] onto stripes 70. [person] that he [roadway] to check status on rangel. [person] that he picked up rangel from the floor and displayed his hands where i observed blood stains. [person] that he asked rangel if he was okay to which rangel stated yeah i am okay according to sirvellos statements. [person] then escorted to port isabel police department for future investigations. a detective from the criminal investigative division was contacted and informed about the events. information was gathered and i resumed patrol duties.#unit 108, body-mic camera #122.

records.deidentified_narrative: i was working a separate crash report when i was waved down by people advising me a child had gotten run over further up on s zarzamora. i arrived to the incident location and observed a child laying supine with individuals around him as well as two vehicles stopped. i learned unit 1 had stayed at the scene and immediately stopped after hitting the pedestrian. witnesses stated ped ran eb across the 1900 blk of s zarzamora when unit 1 was traveling nb on s zarzamora in the number 2 lane. witnesses advised unit 1 was traveling about 30-35 mph and not driving recklessly. the pedestrian was then hit by unit 1. witnesses stated unit 1 ran over the pedestrian's legs and ped ended up on the sidewalk where i located him. unit 1 stated he did not see the child until it was too late and wasn't able to press on his brakes sooner. ped was conscious and alert. i observed scrapes on ped legs and stood by until ems checked on him. i did not observe a crosswalk in the area where witnesses said ped traveled. ems advised ped was not in critical condition and they do not believe ped has any broken bones. ped mom made the location and stood by with ped. ped was transported to uh. i spoke to det. hernandez#2349 and was advised to get the scene processed. det. uribe 2594 took pictures of unit 1 and csi rodriguez #[medical facility]. i contacted det martinez #2407 from tid and he advised me he would not be making the location due to there not being serious bodily injury at the time. sgt. laurenz #3366 was advised of the incident. unit 1 driver was given a citation for not proving proof of liability insurance on scene [identifier]. unit 1 driver did not show any signs of intoxication and was cooperative with police. all witness information is located on the cfs report as well as ped mother. cbn/dmea

a vehicle located in her driveway. when i arrived both parties were separated and unit 1 was parked in the listed pedestrians driveway to perform his duties involved in the repossession of a vehicle. unit 1 driver claimed the pedestrian walked on his vehicles right side while he was reversing with initial drop of the boom for tow was being lowered. unit 1 [roadway] he could have struck the listed pedestrian as he claimed the pedestrian was not near the vehicle while he was reversing. unit 1 driver stated the pedestrian was seen yelling and reached over to the outside passenger door, grabbed the handle, and opened the door. unit 1 driver claimed the passenger went inside her residence and then came outside and stated he struck her with his listed tow truck. unit 1 driver stated his vehicle is equipped with video recording and could validate his statements if we watched the video. when requested access for the view of the video, unit 1 driver stated it is controlled by his supervisor since he was the only one that had the key to unlock the video card. unit 1 driver called his supervisor and he stated he would not give access to the video at this time. unit 1 drivers supervisor stated he wanted police to do a report so his company could later press charges against the listed pedestrian for making a false police report to law enforcement. unit 1 driver was informed how the investigation would be a crash investigation and he would be provided a crash [case id]. unit 1 driver provided all required information to the pedestrian. the listed pedestrian appeared to be limping, had redness to her left lower leg, and an abrasion across the bottom of her shin area. the pedestrian stated she was standing on the sidewalk area in front of her listed residence as unit 1 reversed. the pedestrian stated she yelled at the driver she was standing near his vehicle as he was reversing but was struck by the lower portion of the tow equipment. the pedestrians was interviewed by officer j. spraggins, #1652 and the pedestrian changed her accounts of what occurred by stating she walked towards the area unit 1 was reversing which resulted in unit 1 striking her. last, the pedestrian was walked to where unit 1 was standing and requested that she showed me where she was standing in relation to the roadway. the pedestrian pointed and stated she was on the sidewalk portion of her listed driveway unit 1 reversed and struck her. the pedestrian was provided unit 1's information and did not request emergency medical services for care. traffic investigation unit detective p. davis, #2406 was contacted and informed how unit 1 struck the listed pedestrian in relation to the roadway. coban and body worn camera made available upon request.
